messages:
Olivia (CS): quick heads-up — piloting a Concise Enablement Drop‑In next week for mid-market accounts. 45m slots (30m demo + 15m Q&A), capacity 6 orgs/slot. goal: faster time-to-first-call + migration checklist review. sign-up poll: https://rwd.link/dropin-poll :point_up:

Mike (Enablement): I can cover NA morning slot (PDT). i'll bring the dedicated->private migration checklist and a 5-min template for common infra gotchas. :thumbsup:

Sana (Onboarding): EU afternoon (14:00 BST) works for me. i'll prep the short quickstart (10 slides) and a 1-page pre-req note. can we add a "what to bring" line: org admin + API key?

Priya (Solutions): happy to pair on the demo. can we reserve one slot for customers in renewal window so we can do a targeted refresh? also recommend we record and auto-upload to GH pages (internal) + send link to attendees.

Olivia (CS): yes to renewal-targeted slot — good call. recorder on by default; we'll redact PII in post. brief agenda draft below — feedback welcome:

```
1) 5m - welcome & objectives
2) 10m - quickstart (account + API keys + example requests)
3) 15m - demo: routing, batching, & cost levers (real-world patterns)
4) 10m - migration checklist + gotchas
5) 5m - Q&A and next steps (follow-up playbook)
```

Mike (Enablement): agenda looks tight but doable. can we shorten demo to 12m and use 3 canned examples (chat, embeddings, fallbacks)?

Sana (Onboarding): +1 shorten demo. also propose a 3-question pre-read form so we can tailor examples (region, current infra, main use-case). form link: https://rwd.link/dropin-preread

EnablementBot: RSVP recorded — Olivia (CS), Mike (Enablement), Sana (Onboarding), Priya (Solutions). Remaining seats: 2 for NA slot, 4 for EU slot.

Olivia (CS): logistics: Zoom link will be created per slot (no PMI). please attach slide deck to the calendar invite and cc cs-ops. i'll create the calendar series after poll closes (48h). reminders: /remind @channel 1 day before.

Priya (Solutions): can someone add a short blurb for the renewal slot: "Ideal for teams approaching renewal or capacity planning conversations; bring your billing & throughput questions". i'll draft copy and post here.

Mike (Enablement): tiny ask — can we enable live captions for APAC slots? helps E2E attendees.

Olivia (CS): good point. enable captions + record transcript. post session we'll run a 2-question feedback survey (NPS + one improvement area). feedback form link: https://rwd.link/dropin-feedback

Sana (Onboarding): who owns share-out? i can send the follow-up: recording, slides, checklist, and feedback form within 24h.

Olivia (CS): perfect. volunteers: Mike (NA host), Sana (EU host), Priya (renewal slot lead). i'll finalize once poll closes. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Priya (Solutions): will also queue 2 customer success case studies (5m) — short wins to show before demo.

Olivia (CS): nice. last note: capacity rule — 6 orgs/slot, 2 attendees max per org. we'll enforce during sign-up.
